title: Individual MultiMeshInstance3D mesh normals do not scale with MultiMesh buffer
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: 4.6.3.stable.mono, 4.6.2.stable, 4.6.1.stable, 4.5.1.stable, 4.4.1.stable, 4.3.stable, 4.2.2.stable, 4.1.4.stable, 4.0.4.stable ### System information Godot v4.6.3.stable.mono - Linux Mint 22.3 (Zena) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 SUPER (nvidia; 595.71.05) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-10400F CPU @ 2.90GHz (12 threads) - 23.39 GiB memory ### Issue description scaling an individual mesh of a `MultiMeshInstance3D` using its `buffer` (where the 2D transform is ``, or the 3D transform is `<0, 0, scaleX, 0, scaleY, 0, 0, 0, 0, scaleZ, 0, 0>`) does not also make its normals scale: ###### all of the meshes share the same material and `mesh.res`, shown on top, and have the scale `<1, 3, 1>`. the material is `unshaded`, and sets `ALBEDO` to `NORMAL` in the `fragment` stage this happens in all renderers (Forward+, Mobile, and Compatibility), might be a shader issue ### Steps to reproduce 1. create a `MultiMeshInstance3D` and set its `mesh` to something with angled normals (e.g. `SphereMesh`, not `BoxMesh`) 2. scale one mesh of that `MultiMeshInstance3D` using the `buffer`, and observe how its angled normals do not scale (look at the lighting or shadows) ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [normaltest.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28858076/normaltest.zip)
